title: {Syn} Merkle Trees Hash the Shape of Data
content:
A Merkle tree hashes data in leaves and hashes pairs upward to a root. A short proof path can show that one item belongs to a committed dataset.

This structure appears in version control, blockchains, distributed storage, and transparency logs because it makes tampering visible.

Why it matters: algorithms keeps producing ideas that are simple enough to state and strong enough to build with.
